CENTRO PATE
ORDINANCE M py 22, 2024

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the RS-2 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District symbols
and indications as shown on Map No. 15-N in the area bounded by:
North Navarre Avenue; a line 200 feet southeast of and parallel to North Nashotah Avenue;
the public alley next West of North Navarre Avenue; and, a line 150 feet southeast of and
parallel to North Nashotah Avenue
to those of a RS-3 Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 5842-44 North Navarre Avenue
